purpose: Create a five-second local control draft with per-shot Character Pack reinjection and a separate prior-shot scene-state reference.

referenceRoles.picture-1: Primary identity evidence; use an original Character Pack image.
referenceRoles.picture-2: Second primary identity angle or the second character's authoritative identity image.
referenceRoles.picture-3: Third primary identity angle or secondary-character identity and wardrobe evidence.
referenceRoles.picture-4: Accepted prior-shot scene state for pose, blocking, camera, environment, lighting and object state; never the sole identity source.

exposedSlots.name: prompt
exposedSlots.constraints: Map every <Picture N> tag to one declared role and describe one continuous shot.

exposedSlots.name: referenceImage1ComfyName
exposedSlots.constraints: Filename returned by the trusted ComfyUI upload API; arbitrary local paths are forbidden.

forbiddenOperations: unvalidated fifth through ninth reference image

estimatedRuntime.note: Four-reference business regression completed without OOM; schedule REF2VA shots as one model-affinity batch.

validationChecks: duration is one valid H3 124-frame block
H.264 video and AAC stereo audio are present
REF2VA and sampler nodes execute and do not silently reuse a malformed cached graph
primary identity matches the original Character Pack rather than only the previous tail frame
secondary character identity and wardrobe remain readable when used
scene-state reference controls blocking and environment without overriding identity
no obvious face replacement, duplicated person, black frame or frozen interval
knownFailureSignatures: sending ref_images as an array silently ignores references and can return a cached result
recursive tail-frame identity transfer accumulates facial drift
four references leave little VRAM headroom; higher resolution or more images can OOM
generated speech or subtitles can still be wrong and should move to deterministic post-production
REF2VA and FL2VA cannot remain resident together on the current host
safeRetryPatches: change seed once while preserving reference roles and immutable controls
reduce requested facial or hand motion
replace the scene-state image with a cleaner accepted frame
tighten explicit <Picture N> identity authority in the prompt
fall back to two identity images plus one scene-state image if memory pressure appears

lastValidation.observations: The single-character baseline preserved the original face and wardrobe. Door-story shots 05 and 06 restored the original male identity while retaining the secondary character and doorway state.
